name: @educateos/gatekeeper-clever
description: The Clever gatekeeper (SCHO-282): a Workshop gatekeeper Worker. A user signs in with Clever, which only proves who they are; every read and LMS Connect write uses the district's own district-app token, scoped to the sections that user teaches, is enrolled in, or, for a district administrator, the whole district (audited). Rosters carry names and grade levels only; every change waits for approval.

scripts.dev: echo "run 'pnpm dev-server' in the root directory instead" >&2 && exit 1
scripts.test:run: vp run -F @educateos/gatekeeper-clever build:configurator && vitest run && vitest run -c vitest.worker.config.ts
